actions.reason: C0001 has coherent biological identity evidence: strong, directionally consistent RNA pathway signal (immune/inflammatory and DNA-repair up, heme metabolism down) with a concordant WXS trend (BAP1 enrichment, PBRM1 depletion). Cross-modal diagnostics show positive membership support in all four modalities, estimable internal structure with moderate resampling stability, and positive though small boundaries to C0002. Confounder testing found no significant technical or site association, and known-label echo is minimal. No material unresolved question requires further evidence, so this candidate is retained for downstream validation.

C0002 has coherent biological identity evidence complementary to C0001: strong RNA pathway signal in the opposite direction (heme metabolism up, immune/inflammatory and DNA-repair down) with a concordant WXS trend (PBRM1 enrichment, BAP1 depletion). Cross-modal diagnostics show positive membership support in RNA, WXS, and WSI, estimable internal structure with moderate resampling stability, and positive boundaries to C0001. Confounder testing found no significant technical or site association, and known-label echo is minimal. No material unresolved question requires further evidence, so this candidate is retained for downstream validation.
